items.question: Do you build custom systems only?
items.answer: Yes, I specialize in bespoke Notion systems tailored to your specific needs.

items.question: Can you integrate APIs?
items.answer: Absolutely. I can connect Notion with tools like Slack, Google Calendar, Stripe, and more.

items.question: Do you work with companies?
items.answer: Yes, I work with both individuals and teams to streamline operations.

items.question: What’s the typical timeline?
items.answer: Timelines vary by complexity, but most projects take 2-4 weeks from design to delivery.
